name: the claim marker is gone: a second caller is told it owns the question too
edits:
if qid in fold(read_ledger(root)[0]):
            return False
expect: claim: the first caller owns the question and the second does not, whoever they are

name: a retry no longer removes the state, so a failed question can never be asked again
expect: fold: a retry makes a question eligible again; a baseline id is skipped and cannot be claimed

name: the daily question cap lets one more run through
expect: cap_refusal: refuses AT the cap, not one before it, for questions and for tokens

name: the daily token cap lets one more run through
expect: cap_refusal: refuses AT the cap, not one before it, for questions and for tokens

name: a claim counts as a run, so a question refused by the cap spends the cap
expect: spent: runs and tokens of ONE day — a failed run's tokens count, a claim with no run does not

name: a cap of zero or below is accepted
expect: caps: a set variable that is not a positive number is an error, never the default

name: the headless run gets every tool, not Read alone
expect: argv: the slim start-up, Read as the ONLY tool, and both per-question caps

name: the per-question budget is not passed to the run
expect: argv: the slim start-up, Read as the ONLY tool, and both per-question caps

name: the suite's guard is gone: a self-test could start a binary outside its temp folder
expect: the suite cannot start the real claude: any binary outside its own temp folder is refused

name: a run past its time limit is reported failed but left running
expect: run: past the per-question time limit it is KILLED, and that is a failure with the limit named

name: the KIND line no longer decides: an instruction is treated as a question
expect: reply: the KIND line decides, is never part of the answer, and a missing one means a question

name: a paragraph of the reply reaches the page unescaped
expect: render: every character of the reply is escaped — no tag of the model's reaches the page

name: two matching headings: the answer lands under the first instead of at the end
expect: insert: with no heading, two, or one inside an opaque element, the answer goes to the END and says why

name: opaque elements are not masked, so an answer can land inside a <pre> or a <details>
expect: insert: with no heading, two, or one inside an opaque element, the answer goes to the END and says why

name: a fragment that is a link is written through
expect: a fragment that is a link is never written through

name: a page name may leave the served folder
edits: if not name or name.startswith(".") or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9._-]+", name):
expect: page_name: a page in the served folder, or None — never a path that leaves it

name: a recomposed page that lost the Ask tray replaces the page
expect: a recomposed page without the Ask tray replaces nothing

name: a recomposed page that lost the answer replaces the page
edits: if marker not in composed or
expect: a recomposed page without the answer replaces nothing

name: a live session's edit made mid-answer is overwritten
expect: a live session edits the fragment mid-answer: its edit survives, and the answer goes in once

name: the answerer answers a question a live session claimed
expect: a question a live session claimed is left alone: no run, no write

name: the daily cap is computed and then ignored
expect: daily question cap: the question past the cap is NOT sent to the model, and fails saying so

name: an instruction is answered like a question: no passed-on line
expect: an instruction is NOT acted on: the page says passed on, and it lands in the inbox once

name: an instruction never reaches the inbox
expect: an instruction is NOT acted on: the page says passed on, and it lands in the inbox once

name: the run is not given the served folder to read
expect: the run may read the served folder: its real path is the one --add-dir

name: a refused read is not said on the page
edits:
+ (f" ⚠ {run.denied} of its file reads were REFUSED, so it may have answered without them."
                    if run.denied else ""))
expect: a run whose file reads were refused says so on the page and in the log — never a silent guess

name: an unforeseen fault leaves the claim open instead of a failed question
edits:
except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 — the boundary: an unforeseen fault is a LOUD failed question
        reason = f"the answerer itself failed ({type(exc).__name__}: {str(exc)[:200]})"
expect: a fault inside the answerer is a FAILED question with its cause, never a claim left open

name: a stop mid-answer records nothing for the question it was on
edits:
record(root, {"e": "failed", "id": q.id, "doc": q.doc, "question": q.text[:600], "at": now_text(),
                      "reason": "the answerer was stopped while answering this one", "tokens": tokens})
expect: a stop mid-answer: the question is recorded NOT answered before the watcher exits

name: a later start answers the backlog asked while no answerer ran
expect: a later start skips what was asked while no answerer ran — and --retry makes one eligible

name: a question a dead answerer left claimed stays claimed for ever
expect: on start, a question a dead answerer left claimed becomes NOT ANSWERED; a session's claim stays

name: recovery fails a live session's claim too
expect: on start, a question a dead answerer left claimed becomes NOT ANSWERED; a session's claim stays

name: the panel shows a failure's reason unescaped
expect: panel: a failed question says NOT ANSWERED, with its reason escaped and the retry command

name: the panel assumes the served bytes hold every answer, so one they lack is never shown
expect: panel: an answer the served bytes do NOT hold is shown in full, however old

name: the panel shows every page's questions on every page
expect: panel: a page shows only the questions asked on IT

name: a machine where the answerer never ran gets a panel
edits:
events, _bad = read_ledger(root)
    if not events:
        return []
    events, _bad = read_ledger(root)
expect: no ledger (the answerer never ran on this machine): no panel and no rev

name: the revision ignores a question's state, so an open page never reloads on an answer
edits: key = [(it["id"], it.get("status"), it.get("by"), bool(it.get("written"))) for it in items]
expect: rev: moves whenever a question on the page changes state, so an open page reloads
